text:
mira: Quick dump from this morning's stochastic handshake / speculative decode experiment with draft model 'dorado-lite-13b-quant'. Short summary: 18–22% token latency reduction, ~0.6 ROUGE/ BLEU-ish quality drop on long-form extraction prompts.

sam: Link to raw logs + perf table? Also which eval harness/config did you use?

mira: Putting logs + artifacts here: gs://redwood-experiments/handshake/6129993333.tar.gz. git rev: 3f4b8f2.

mira: Repro command I used:
```
./run_eval --model dorado-lite-13b-quant \
           --decode speculative-handshake \
           --handshake-window 3 \
           --kv-ttl 120 \
           --seed 42
```

leo: Clarify: handshake-window=3 -> precompute 3 tokens ahead and accept if top-1 matches fallback?

mira: Right. We prefetch 3 tokens using a cheap sampler (temp=0.8, topk=50) and verify incremental matches against the heavyweight beam. If mismatch, we fallback and patch the output.

ara: What failure modes did you see? hallucinations on long QA? numeric drift?

mira: Mostly numeric/code exact-match regressions and occasional token-shift in enumerations. Example: expected "42" but produced "40" in a unit-conversion QA; non-exact paraphrase metrics (BLEU/ROUGE) were mostly stable.

eval-bot: eval-bot: run complete: /evals/6142/handshake-run-6129993333.json. Metrics snapshot: p50 latency -18.4%, p95 -11.2%, ROUGE-L delta -0.6, ExactMatch delta -0.3.

natalie: Seed sensitivity? Can we get confidence intervals with multiple seeds?

mira: Yes planning 5-seed sweep next. I also pushed a tiny reproducer: /tmp/handshake_repro.tar.gz and repro script: `python repro.py --case 17 --seed 42`.

sam: Ops: before any dedicated canary, we should run a short A/B on a low-traffic pool. ops-bot can you provision a slot?

ops-bot: ops-bot: Scheduled canary window Sat 03:00 UTC on 2 low-priority GPUs. Alerts + rollback hooks enabled.

leo: Proposed next experiments:
- handshake-window=2,3,4 sweep
- compare quantized vs fp16 (same decode path)
- longer codebench and numericbench runs for regression sensitivity

ara: +1 to adding a precision-penalty signal to catch numeric drift early (e.g., numeric-EM or digit-edit-distance).

mira: I'll collect artifacts, run the multi-seed sweep, and post a short follow-up doc with examples and a reproducible checklist. cc @natalie @sam

sam: thanks — please add the specific eval IDs and a short table of examples (good/bad) in the doc.

mira: Will do. TL;DR: promising latency wins, small but actionable quality regressions concentrated in numerics/code. Next: sweep seeds/windows + stricter numeric metrics before canary.
__note: No title field included per agents.md; thread is a single continuous Slack string with messages in chronological order.
